rules.content:
// Microsoft Sentinel KQL: Detect AiTM session token replay
// User-Agent or IP mismatch between MFA completion and subsequent access
let mfa_events = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where AuthenticationRequirement == "multiFactorAuthentication"
| where ResultType == 0
| project MFATime=TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, MFA_IP=IPAddress,
          MFA_UserAgent=UserAgent, MFA_AppId=AppId;
let access_events = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType == 0
// Exclude MFA events to prevent self-join noise
| where AuthenticationRequirement != "multiFactorAuthentication"
| project AccessTime=TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, Access_IP=IPAddress,
          Access_UserAgent=UserAgent, Access_AppId=AppId;
mfa_events
| join kind=inner access_events on UserPrincipalName
// Access must occur 5min–4h after MFA (skip trivially close auth flow events)
| where AccessTime > MFATime + 5m and AccessTime < MFATime + 4h
| where MFA_IP != Access_IP or MFA_UserAgent != Access_UserAgent
| project UserPrincipalName, MFATime, AccessTime,
          MFA_IP, Access_IP, MFA_UserAgent, Access_UserAgent
rules.title: DL-0137: AiTM Session Token Replay Detection — User-Agent and IP Mismatch Post-MFA (KQL)

rules.content:
// Microsoft Sentinel KQL: Inbox rule manipulation after new-IP authentication
let new_ip_signins = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(48h)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
| where FirstSeen > ago(24h);
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Operation in ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "Enable-InboxRule")
| join kind=inner new_ip_signins on $left.UserId == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where TimeGenerated > FirstSeen
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation, Parameters, ClientIP, IPAddress
rules.title: DL-0138: Post-Compromise Inbox Rule Manipulation — Rule Creation After New-IP Authentication (KQL)

rules.content:
// KQL: AiTM Session Token Replay Detection
// Detects same SessionId used from multiple IPs (proxy + attacker)
let timeWindow = 4h;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize
    IPCount = dcount(IPAddress),
    IPs = make_set(IPAddress),
    UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent),
    AppIds = make_set(AppId),
    MinTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    MaxTime = max(TimeGenerated),
    RiskLevels = make_set(RiskLevelDuringSignIn)
  by SessionId, UserPrincipalName
| where IPCount >= 2
| where datetime_diff('hour', MaxTime, MinTime) <= 4
| project UserPrincipalName, SessionId, IPCount, IPs, UserAgents,
          AppIds, MinTime, MaxTime, RiskLevels
rules.title: DL-0146: AiTM Session Token Replay — Same SessionId from Multiple IPs (KQL)

rules.content:
// KQL: Sneaky 2FA Impossible Device Shift Detection
// Correlates mismatched User-Agents within same authentication flow
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize
    UACount = dcount(UserAgent),
    UserAgents = make_set(UserAgent),
    IPs = make_set(IPAddress),
    MinTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    MaxTime = max(TimeGenerated)
  by CorrelationId, UserPrincipalName
| where UACount >= 2
| where datetime_diff('minute', MaxTime, MinTime) <= 10
// Convert dynamic array to string for substring matching
| extend UA_str = tostring(UserAgents)
// High confidence: Safari/iOS + Edge/Windows combination (Sneaky 2FA signature)
| where (UA_str has "Safari" and UA_str has "Edge")
    or (UA_str has "iPhone" and UA_str has "Windows")
| project UserPrincipalName, CorrelationId, UACount, UserAgents,
          IPs, MinTime, MaxTime
rules.title: DL-0147: Sneaky 2FA Impossible Device Shift — User-Agent Mismatch per Auth Step (KQL)

rules.content:
// KQL: Rockstar 2FA / FlowerStorm Detection
// Matches hardcoded AppId and WebView/3.0 User-Agent
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where AppId == "72782ba9-4490-4f03-8d82-562370ea3566"
| where UserAgent contains "WebView/3.0"
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, UserAgent,
          AppId, ResultType, RiskLevelDuringSignIn,
          Location, ConditionalAccessStatus
rules.title: DL-0148: Rockstar 2FA / FlowerStorm Application ID and User-Agent Detection (KQL)

rules.content:
// KQL: Post-AiTM Inbox Rule Manipulation Detection
// Correlates risky sign-ins with subsequent inbox rule changes
let risky_signins = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("medium", "high")
    or RiskLevelAggregated in ("medium", "high")
| where ResultType == 0
| project SignInTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, SignInIP = IPAddress,
          RiskLevel = RiskLevelDuringSignIn;
let inbox_changes = OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Operation in ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "Enable-InboxRule", "Set-Mailbox")
| where Parameters has_any ("ForwardTo", "ForwardAsAttachmentTo", "RedirectTo",
                             "DeleteMessage", "MarkAsRead")
| project RuleTime = TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, Operation, Parameters;
risky_signins
| join kind=inner inbox_changes
    on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.UserId
| where RuleTime between (SignInTime .. (SignInTime + 24h))
| project UserPrincipalName, SignInTime, SignInIP, RiskLevel,
          RuleTime, Operation, Parameters, ClientIP
rules.title: DL-0150: Post-AiTM Inbox Rule Manipulation — New Rules from Risky Sign-In (KQL)
